message.content:
A typical medium tomato (about 123 g or 4 oz) contains roughly **22 calories**.  
- Small tomatoes (≈ 70 g) are around **12–15 calories**.  
- Large tomatoes (≈ 180 g) can reach **30–35 calories**.

So, for most everyday uses, you can round to about **20–25 calories per medium tomato**.
